hypotheses.A0_integrated_component_atlas_recomposes: The integrated output-gradient allocation over carried, MLP, every Layer-17 head/source relation, and numerical residual recomposes the finite spelling contrast to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.A1_known_L17H2_boundary_is_recovered: L17H2-boundary ranks among the five largest positive attention components in every fold/split cell.
hypotheses.A2_nonboundary_attention_is_not_one_comp: No single nonboundary head/relation component accounts for more than half of positive nonboundary attention contribution in any cell.
hypotheses.A3_nonboundary_attention_is_broad: The four largest positive nonboundary head/relation components account for less than 90% of positive nonboundary contribution in every cell.
hypotheses.A4_top_nonboundary_relation_replicates: The source-relation class of the largest nonboundary component agrees across both splits for at least two of three folds.
